message.content: Interesting - the source already has the fix applied (using `char selname[256]`). But the task says this is a vulnerability that needs a PoC. Let me check if the binaries in work-vul were compiled from the unfixed source. Let me check the git history more carefully:

content:
f694a02 Fix oss-fuzz issue 44008: overflow in pixCountArbInRect() in pix3_fuzzer.cc * Bug in pixel access in pixCountArbInRect(): using wrong depth * Now allow use on all pix with depth <= 8
748723a Fix oss-fuzz issue 43841: overflow in pixCountPixels() in pix3_fuzzer.cc * Caused by illegal pointer in the fuzzer program for tab8. * Also fixed the cropping in pixCountPixelsInRect().  It was allowing   an arbitrarily large pix to be made.  No error in counting, but a   waste of heap memory.
a0b5960 Fix issue 29819: Heap-buffer-overflow in fdilate_1_56 * Illegal use of a function; fix documentation to reflect this. * Fix some bugs in flipdetect_fuzzer and pix3_fuzzer. * Limit size of sel generated from a template pix. * Remove large output data in dwamorph1_reg, unless display is requested * Added new reg test: binmorph6_reg.c
c3b2f15 Oss-fuzz issue 29117: finditalic_fuzzer: heap overflow * substituteObjectNumbers() was not checking array bounds * also fixed enhance_fuzzer.cc * also fixed documentation in enhance.c
b454359 Fixed oss-fuzz issue 28847, timeout reading a tiff payload. * The read function finished in 41 seconds on the office linux box.   This is too long for the fuzzing test.  The tiff read callback   reported bad data, where there is either an overflow or an attempt   to read past the high water mark.  Unfortunately, we can't use that   error to abort the read. * The fuzzer attempted to decode the payload using the new   (4.1.0, 2019) tifflib package that uses libwebp.  We don't use external   libraries when encoding or decoding tiff files (except for libz),   so now explicitly do not support the COMPRESSION_WEBP encoding or decoding.
8b06c6b Fix oss-fuzz issue 24134: dewarp_fuzzer: rasterop buffer overflow. * The bitblit (rasterop) operations gave the correct result, because the   bits read from a word beyond the image were masked out and not used.   But the memory sanitizers (e.g., valgrand) noticed the read error. * This also fixed an illegal 4 byte read (leptonica issue #534),   found by Nam Le Duc. * Also fix pix4_fuzzer.c. * Also remove unused variables from 4 prog functions. * Add instructions for building fuzzers to README.html.
13f812c Fix buffer overflow in sreadHeaderSpix (found by cluster-fuzz)
c0fb788 Issue 24134 in oss-fuzz: Heap-buffer-overflow in rasteropGeneralLow() * From dewarp_fuzzer.  Check intermediate images; simplify   pixFillMapHoles().  This may have fixed the issue.
5ba34b1 Issue 23654 in oss-fuzz: Heap-buffer-overflow in pixReadFromTiffStream   * Increase scanline buffer for reading gray+alpha and converting to RGBA
8d6e175 Issue 23433 in oss-fuzz: Heap-buffer-overflow in findNextBorderPixel() * Check pix boundary when looking for the next pixel.
3c18c43 Fixing oss-fuzz issue 22512: Heap-buffer-overflow in rasteropGeneralLow() * Simplified the hole-filling function `
33e0c89 Fixed oss-fuzz issue 22295: Heap-buffer-overflow in pixGetRGBComponentCmap() * use converted RGB pix when extracting components * prevent indexing overflow into colormap * extra checks in pixSetColormap() and pixCopyColormap() * do not use pixSetColormap() in pixTransferAllData(), because at the   time the colormap is transferred, the colormap and destination pix can   have diffeent depths.
5ee24b3 Fixed issue 22140 in oss-fuzz: Heap-buffer-overflow * color quantized pix must be 8 bpp before extra colors are added.
3ddd9a3 Fix heap buffer overflow in selReadStream
4bc12a9 Avoid left shift by 16 bits into signed int * Found as issue 22015 in oss-fuzz: Undefined-shift in scaleColorLILow
36f93b7 Avoid left shift by 24 bits into signed int * Found as issue 21997 in oss-fuzz: Undefined-shift in pixConvert2To8
59fb599 Check barcode string length for validity. * this fixes buffer overflow found in oss-fuzz by Adam Korczynski. * also remove several declarations not following a brace
06b279a Fuzzer found buffer overflow reading old jpeg tiff format - hypothesize the depth is less than 8
7f9bb88 Put maxima on allocations for common leptonica data structures. * pixa, pixaa, pixcomp, pixacomp, boxa, boxaa, sarray, pta, ptaa,   dna, numa, numaa, fpixa * use size_t for input params to avoid integer overflow * enforce both when creating the struct and extending the arrays.
85ec8a3 Better fix for interger overflow in area map function * Do not allow scale factors that are too small (i.e., small enough   to cause overflows)
b8168fa Fix two issues found by sanitizers: * msan uninitialized data in pixReduce*Binary2(). * asan signed integer overflow error in scaleColorAreaMapLow()
50c3c35 Fix bit shift overflow in bmp reading.
7d72d9f Fix overflow bug in pixMedianCut(). * Find the max of the key, and use that to normalize the product   of occupancy and size in color space. * Add new heap accessor lheapGetElement() of the bare array. * Also make two low-level heap operations static. * Also add a function pixMultiplyGray() that allows multiplying a pix   by a (possibly subsampled) array (i.e., another pix). * In pdf generation, handle an spp = 4 RGBA pix with non-opaque alpha   channel by projecting a white background through any transparency,   resulting in a spp = 3 pix.
d15f1c2 Compiler complains about possible overflows in strncat. * Removed all instances, replacing with stringCat(). * Fixed stringCat() to do nothing in case of error Also, small changes for scaling resolution.
1907c8e Cast to uint32 values that are being left-shifted in macro and non-macro pixel-setting functions.  This avoid the possibility of overflow if the compiler does not do the cast implicitly. In fact, no problems have ever been reported with these functions on any platform, but the asan fuzzers are very picky.
f414750 New string replacement function * tested in string_reg.c * new prog/replacebytes uses it * also fixed prog/reg_wrapper.sh to identify boxa3_reg and boxa4_reg   as having a dependency on gnuplot * also eliminated cast overflow for resolution in jp2kheader.c,   found by the fuzzer.
73ade46 Fix signed int cast overflow in tiff reading * found by Google fuzzers * issue #377
5d4aca0 Fix signed int overflow in bmp reading * found by Google fuzzers * issue #378
c5283f7 Fix potential int overflow problem with tiff reading found by tiff fuzzer
a7aa5d8 Fix issues found by lgtm.com using static analysis. * These are mostly potential overflows. * There are also a few unnecessary logic tests.
faf9da9 Added casts to properly guard against array size overflows. * Also simplified splitimage2pdf.c.  It no longer uses ps2pdf.
ee301cb Security fixes: expect final changes for release 1.75.3. * Fixed a debian security issue with fscanf() reading a string with   possible buffer overflow. * There were also a few similar situations with sscanf().
e72cad0 Small fixes (sleep removal, nan handling, size_t output) * more efficient method of handling nan in affine (etc) transforms * removed sleep commands from 7 tests; no longer needed for gplot * fixed bug in fpix2.c causing incorrect overflow count in   fpixConvertToPix() * fixed fprintf control string for size_t output in prog/mtifftest.c
